title: MV Having problems with YEP_X Item Categories & YEP Item Synthesis behaving together

posts.author: SuperPhillip
posts.body:
Hey all. Struggling with an issue in RPG Maker MV involving a custom armor category with YEP_X Item Categories plugin and Item Synthesis.
I wanted to separate my game's general armor (tunics, for instance), from accessories, and other things RPG Maker MV declares initially without plugins as "Armors". The problem with this that I'm having is that when I use the Yanfly Item Synthesis menu for armor, it doesn't show any of them whatsoever, as seen in the final screenshot attached. I've tried to tinker, even changing the category name to Clothing, then changing the notetags to Clothing, and the Open Synthesis plugin command to Clothing, but the result was the same. What am I looking in these screenshots?
Thanks for any help, and if you need further info, please let me know.

posts.author: coucassi
posts.body:
Heyho!
It seems that you missed the "Category:" before someof entries of the category order in your plugin manager. Also, in the note field of your tunics notebook you added the armor recipe notetag twice, one referring to the notebook itself, which would make it it own recipe. Maybe those things are messing with the plugins, so I would recommend to fix them at first.
Also, as always with Yanfly plugins, take a look at your plugin order. Yanfly's Plugins need to be placed in a specific order in your plugin manager to work correctly, which you can find on his
website
.

Hi, coucassi! Thanks for the advice as a means to start. I truly appreciate it.
Some of the entries are the standard/default ones for the plugin (i.e. the ones without "Category:" in front of them, such as "Weapons" and "KeyItems", so putting "Category:" in front of them disrupts the format.
But I ended up solving it! I had to use "EType:x" instead of "Category:Armor" or "Category:Accessories" to show the "Equipment" number for "x" listed in my "Equipment Types" section of the "System" section of the Database, rather than make my own custom category. The crafting shop works beautifully now--for armor and accessories, too!
